verses.en: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
verses.sm: Iosefa î Aikupito Ona alu atu lea o Isaraelu ma ana mea uma, ua 00 atu foi i Peresepa; ua fai ai foi o taulaga i le Atua o lona tama o Isaako.

verses.en: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai lea o le Atua ja Isaraelu i le faaaliga i le po, ua faapea mai, Iakopo, Iakopo e! ona tali mai ai lea o ia, O aʻu lenei.

verses.en: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai lea o ia, O aʻu nei o le Atua, o le Atua o lou tama; aua e te fefe i alu ifo i Aikupito, aua ou te faia oe ma nuu tele.

verses.en: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.
verses.sm: O aʻu nei ta te o ifo ma oe i Aikupito, ou te toe aveina ae ai foi ia te oe; e tuu foi e losefa ona lima i luga o ou mata.

verses.en: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
verses.sm: Ona tulai atu lea o lakopo i Peresepa, ua avea foi e atalii o Isaraelu lo latou tama o lakopo, ma o latou tama iti, ma a latou ava i fata faataavalevale na aauina mai e Farao e ave ai o ia.

verses.en: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:
verses.sm: Ua latou avea foi a latou manu ma a latou oloa sa maua e i latou i le nuu o Kanana, i loo ua latou co atu i Aikupito, o lakopo atoa uma ma ana fanau faatasi ma ia;

verses.en: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.
verses.sm: o ona atalii ma atalii o ona atalii faatasi ma ia, o ona afafine foi atoa ma afafine o ona atalii, ma lana fanau uma lava, ua latou o atu faatasi ma ia i Aikupito.

verses.en: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn.
verses.sm: O igoa nei o atalii o Isaraelu o e na o atu i Aikupito, o Iakopo ma ona atalii; o le ulumatua a lakopo o Reupena;

verses.en: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.sm: o atalii o Reupena; o Enoka, ma Falu, ma Esarona, atoa ma Karame.

verses.en: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Simeona; o Iemuelu, ma laminu, ma Oata, ma lakinu, ma Soaro, atoa ma Saulo, o le tama lea a le fafine Kanana.

verses.en: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Levi; o Keresoma, O Koato, atoa ma Merari.

verses.en: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zerah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Iuta; o Eru, ma Onani, ma Sila, ma Faresa, atoa ma Sera; (a ua oti Eru ma Onani ile nuu o Kanana;) o atalii o Faresa; o Esarona ma Hamulu.

verses.en: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.
verses.sm: O atalii o Isakara; o Tulaga, ma Pua, ma lopu, atoa ma Semarona.

verses.en: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Sepulona; o Seretu, ma Aluna, ma lalelu.

verses.en: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
verses.sm: O tama tane lava i latou a Lea, na ia fanau ia lakopo i Patanarama, atoa ma lona afafine o Tina; o ona atalii atoa ia ma ona afafine ua toatolugafulu ma le toatolu.

verses.en: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.
verses.sm: O atalii o Kato; o Sefiono, ma Haki, ma Suni, ma Eseponu, ma Eri, ma Aroti, atoa ma Areli.

verses.en: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Asera; o Iemina, ma lesiva, ma lesivi, atoa ma Peria, i le ma lo latou tuafafine o Sera; o atalii foi o Peria; o Kaveru ma Mekielu.

verses.en: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.
verses.sm: O tama nei a Selepa, o le na avatua e Lapana i lona afafine o Lea, na ia fanau mai i latou ia Iakopo, o tama e toatinoagafulu ma le toaono.

verses.en: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.
verses.sm: O tama a Rasela, le aya a lakopo; o Iosefa ma Peniamina.

verses.en: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.
verses.sm: Na fanau foi ia Iosefa i le nuu o Aikupito, o e na fanau ia te ia ia Asenati o le afafine lea o Potifere le ositaulaga i Onu; o Manase ma Efaraima.

verses.en: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Peniamina; o Pela, ma Pekaru, ma Asepelu, o Kira, ma Naamanu, o Aki, ma Roso, o Mepimu, ma Hupimo, atoa ma Aratu.

verses.en: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
verses.sm: O tama tane ia a Rasela na ia fanau ia lakopo, o i latou atoa, o tagata e toatinoagafulu ma le toafa.

verses.en: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.
verses.sm: O le atalii foi o Tanu; o Husimo.

verses.en: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.sm: O atalii o Nafatali; o lasielu, ma Kuni, ma lesaru, atoa ma Selimo.

verses.en: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.
verses.sm: O tama nei a Pila, o le na avatua e Lapana i lona afafine o Rasela, na ia fanau mai i latou ia Iakopo, o ona atoa ia o tama e toafitu.

verses.en: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six;
verses.sm: O tagata uma na o mai ma lakopo i Aikupito, e na tutupu mai ia te ia, a e le faitaulia ava a atalii o lakopo, o Ona atoa O tagata uma e toaonogafulu ma le toaono. Ua ta'ita'iina e Iosefa lona tamā i

verses.en: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.
verses.sm: O atalii o Iosefa e na fanau ia te ia i Aikupito, o tama e toalua; o tagata atoa uma o le aiga o Iakopo e na o mai i Aikupito e toafitugafulu lava i latou.

verses.en: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
verses.sm: Ua ia awna atu foi Iuta e muamua atu ja te ia ia Iosefa, ina ia faasino e ia ia te ia o Kosena; ona oo atu lea o i latou i le laueleele o Kosena.

verses.en: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
verses.sm: Ona sauni lea e Iosefa o lona nofoa faataavalevale, ua alu ae foi i Kosena la te fetaiai ai ma lona tama o Isaraelu; ua na iloa atu ia te ia, ona fusi ai lea ia te ia, ma tagi pea lava i lona ua.

verses.en: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Israelu ia Iosefa, Ia aʻu oti nei lava, ina ua ou iloa atu ou mata, auã ua e ola pea lava.

verses.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father's house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
verses.sm: 'Ona fai atu lea o Iosefa i ona uso ma le aiga o lona tamā, Ou te alu ae ma ou taʻu atu ia Farao, ou te fai atu ia te ja, Ua o mai ia te au oʻu uso ma le aiga o loʻu tamā o e sa i le nuu o Kanana;

verses.en: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
verses.sm: o leoleo mamoe i latou, auā o tagata faga manu i latou; ua au mai a latou lafu mamoe, ma a latou povi, ma mea uma lava o loo ia i latou.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
verses.sm: A aami mai foi Farao ia te outou, ma fesili ia te outou, Se a lo outou faiva?

verses.en: That ye shall say, Thy servants' trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
verses.sm: Ona outou fai atu ai lea, O tagata faga manu au auauna talu ina o taulelea i matou ua oo mai i Ona po nei, o i matou atoa ma o matou tamā; tou te faapea atu, ina ia nofo outou i le laueleele o Kosena; auā ua inosia lava e le nuu o luma o
